scripts.dev:services:down: docker compose stop mongo redis minio neo4j
scripts.dev: npm run dev:services && concurrently --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.docker:down: docker compose --env-file api/.env --profile app --profile full down
scripts.docker:full: docker compose --env-file api/.env --profile app --profile full up -d --build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix web test
